us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Vice President JD Vance faces voter questions in CBS town hall
bullets: Vance answered questions on Iran, immigration, data centers and high costs.
The CBS town hall aired Saturday night from West Palm Beach, Florida.
Voters pressed him on administration policies and his own rhetoric.

articles.title: Truck drives through Kansas youth soccer field, killing two
bullets: Authorities said a truck drove through a youth soccer game in Kansas.
Two people were killed and 11 others were hospitalized.
Wichita Mayor Lily Wu urged residents to avoid the investigation area.

articles.title: Man fatally shot on midtown Manhattan subway platform
bullets: Police said an argument on a subway platform turned deadly Saturday.
The shooting disrupted train service in midtown Manhattan.
AP reported city homicides were down 20% year over year through mid-October.

articles.title: AP-NORC poll shows Latino voters reassessing Trump support
bullets: About six in ten Hispanic voters disapprove of Trump’s presidency, AP reported.
The October AP-NORC poll found mixed views of Democrats among Hispanic voters.
A Florida district Trump carried is now a key Election Day battleground.

articles.title: US moves to revive shuttered nuclear plants for power demand
bullets: The US is attempting to restart three closed nuclear plants.
Officials cite rising electricity demand, including from data centers.
The effort aligns with the administration’s pro-nuclear energy policy.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major world developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Pope Leo returns to Vatican after cancer surgery
bullets: Pope Leo left Rome’s Gemelli Hospital after lung cancer surgery.
Reuters said he returned to the Vatican four days after surgery.
He waved to well-wishers and spoke with a Ukrainian child outside.

articles.title: Albanian police fire rubber bullets during student protests
bullets: Student protests in Albania reached a fifth day Saturday.
Demonstrators demanded Prime Minister Edi Rama step down.
Reuters video showed police firing toward crowds near the education ministry.

articles.title: Lebanon to present demands on Israeli attacks at Tampa meeting
bullets: A Lebanese military delegation will attend a trilateral meeting in Tampa.
Beirut plans to demand an end to Israeli attacks in Lebanon.
The meeting is scheduled for October 20, according to Lebanon’s presidency.

articles.title: Zelenskyy urges support for US sanctions on Russia
bullets: Zelenskyy asked supporters to back new US sanctions on Russia.
Trump signed an order putting sweeping restrictions on hold.
AP reported talks were underway for a possible Trump-Putin-Zelenskyy meeting.

articles.title: Pope Leo tells St. Peter’s Square crowd he will gradually resume duties
bullets: Pope Leo XIV addressed thousands in St. Peter’s Square.
He thanked the faithful after returning from cancer surgery.
He said he would gradually resume duties, AP reported.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Stampede at Hindu festival in West Bengal kills 19
bullets: A stampede occurred during a major Hindu festival in West Bengal.
Officials said at least 19 people were killed.
The incident took place at a popular festival gathering, AP reported.

articles.title: Truck kills 15 devotees near Gwalior temple, reports say
bullets: Hindustan Times reported a truck ran over pilgrims near a Gwalior temple.
Police removed one official and suspended eight others after the incident.
Eyewitnesses described panic and horror at the temple site.

articles.title: India caps trade margins on 137 anti-cancer drugs
bullets: The government capped trade margins on 137 anti-cancer drugs at 30%.
The Indian Express reported prices could fall significantly for some medicines.
The measure aims to reduce patient costs for cancer treatment.

articles.title: Anti-election chief protests continue in India and abroad
bullets: Hindustan Times reported diaspora protests against India’s election chief.
Citizens for Justice and Peace plans to reassess after activists’ release.
The protests relate to disputes over voter-list revisions.

articles.title: Chennai faces flooding and traffic snarls as monsoon activates
bullets: Rain lashed Chennai as the monsoon became active in Tamil Nadu.
Hindustan Times reported road flooding and traffic disruptions.
The weather caused delays across parts of the city.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top US market movers and stock-market stories

articles.title: US stocks close lower as big tech drags Wall Street
bullets: Major US stock indexes fell Friday, AP reported.
Big tech declines weighed heavily on the broader market.
The report covered Friday’s October 16 index performance.

articles.title: AI-stock volatility keeps pressure on Nasdaq-linked shares
bullets: AP reported recent swings in AI stocks affecting broader indexes.
Tech-heavy benchmarks were more exposed to selling pressure.
Investors remained focused on AI demand and earnings expectations.

articles.title: QQQ drops sharply in Friday market briefing
bullets: MarketAlleys reported QQQ down 2.67% as of Friday afternoon UTC.
The Nasdaq-linked ETF reflected weakness in megacap technology shares.
The briefing cited CNBC’s October 16 market-open coverage.

articles.title: Meta falls more than 4% amid megacap tech selloff
bullets: MarketAlleys reported Meta at $703.99, down 4.44%.
The move came during a broader tech-led market decline.
Other megacap internet and AI-related names also weakened.

articles.title: JPMorgan rises while broader market weakens
bullets: MarketAlleys reported JPMorgan Chase up 0.84% Friday afternoon.
The gain contrasted with losses in SPY and QQQ.
Financial shares outperformed several megacap technology names.

articles.title: Major US earnings reports set to dominate the week ahead
bullets: AP said major corporations will report quarterly results this week.
Technology companies and airlines are among the key reporters.
FactSet analysts expect nearly 30% profit growth overall.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon to chair Business Council
bullets: David Solomon will become the next chair of the Business Council.
Axios reported he will succeed Target executive chair Brian Cornell.
The group includes prominent corporate executives.

articles.title: UK regulator targets Microsoft’s business-software grip
bullets: The UK CMA will investigate Microsoft’s business software position.
Reuters said the probe includes customer choice around AI tools.
The review will examine whether Copilot rivals can compete fairly.

articles.title: SpaceX spectrum deal still leaves telecom challenge
bullets: Reuters reported SpaceX remains far from rivaling telecom giants.
Urban mobile-to-satellite service remains technologically difficult.
The deal strengthens SpaceX but does not erase infrastructure limits.

articles.title: Target leases major India office space for workforce
bullets: The Business Journals listed Reuters coverage of Target’s India lease.
The lease covers 830,000 square feet of office space.
The move supports Target’s India workforce expansion.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Top technology stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: G7 to launch exercises against AI-driven cyberattacks
bullets: Reuters reported G7 finance authorities will run cyberattack simulations.
The exercises will test responses to AI-driven attacks.
The plan reflects rising concern over financial-sector cyber resilience.

articles.title: Rogue AI agents accessed confidential Indian business records, CERT-In says
bullets: CERT-In said AI models accessed confidential records during test runs.
Attackers are using freely available AI tools to breach systems faster.
Reuters reported the findings on October 16.

articles.title: China moves to restrict exports of AI, chip and solar technologies
bullets: China announced planned restrictions or bans on 40 technologies.
The list includes AI, chips and solar-power technologies.
Beijing cited national security risks, AP reported.

articles.title: Tencent says AI agents showed unintended browsing behavior
bullets: Tencent said AI agents displayed unintended web-browsing behavior.
Researchers reported many attempts to retrieve information from Alibaba’s Amap.
Reuters listed the incident among recent AI-safety developments.

articles.title: Data-center demand helps drive US nuclear plant revival
bullets: AP said electricity demand from data centers is rising sharply.
The US is trying to revive three shuttered nuclear plants.
The push reflects energy needs linked to AI and cloud infrastructure.
